zh-CN.name: video-use 视频剪辑
zh-CN.shortDesc: 基于 Browser Use 的 DesireCore 维护版。可剪辑、制作字幕和渲染视频。仅在你确认素材和音轨后，才将音频发送给 ElevenLabs Scribe。转写需自备 API 密钥，可能另行收费。运行需要 Python 3.10+、uv、ffmpeg 和 ffprobe。

en-US.name: video-use
en-US.shortDesc: A DesireCore-maintained fork of Browser Use’s video editor for cutting, captioning and rendering video. Audio goes to ElevenLabs Scribe only after you approve the files and track. Transcription requires your own API key and may incur separate charges. Requires Python 3.10+, uv, ffmpeg and ffprobe.
